    Cleaving out of bipartite quivers #

    If a thin quiver has no path of length two (every vertex is a source or a sink), the local criterion PathCat.ArrowCleaving reduces to the zigzag conditions: arrow images are nonzero and not invertible, two arrows with a common source do not factor through each other on the right, and two arrows with a common target do not factor through each other on the left (RayCat.PathCat.arrowCleaving_of_bip).
